name: The Gangstas

tenures.source: The Second Annual Sabby Awards, IWL Newsletter #222, 15 December 1997 (promotions/iwl-international-1997/archive/iwl-international-sabbies-1997-12-15.html).

caption: Named Funniest In-Ring Moment at the IWL's own Second Annual Sabby Awards, December 1997, for a see-saw spot on Ron Simmons and Konnan (with an assist to Yokozuna) at Balance of Power 1996; the award was accepted by manager Jim Crockett, the team itself having left the IWL by the time of the ceremony.

name: The Hard Corps

tenures.source: The Second Annual Sabby Awards, IWL Newsletter #222, 15 December 1997 (promotions/iwl-international-1997/archive/iwl-international-sabbies-1997-12-15.html).

caption: An at least seven-strong stable managed by Scott Bowden and including Sabu, Dean Malenko, Eddy Guerrero, Chris Benoit, and Public Enemy; named Best Stable at the IWL's own Second Annual Sabby Awards, December 1997, over the Corporate, the Triple Crown, the World Alliance, the Orient Express, and the Watchmen.

name: The Odd Couple

tenures.source: The Second Annual Sabby Awards, IWL Newsletter #222, 15 December 1997 (promotions/iwl-international-1997/archive/iwl-international-sabbies-1997-12-15.html).

name: Public Enemy
